node.title: PMA sigma-one diffuse defect-three hyperplane reduction
node.statement: Every finite sigma=1 diffuse (d,r)=(3,0) source object yields a nonzero five-point divided-difference hyperplane in the elementary symmetric coefficients of its split cubic core locator. Each fixed hyperplane contains fewer than (k-1)^2/2 split locators, giving the field-independent aggregate bound 16(k-1)^2 C((n-k)/2,5). The remaining endpoint is a one-power aggregate saving or a global owner, not an arbitrary auxiliary list.
